name: Conversation and geography: as-is capability pilot
note: Three cases / six turns. Use --mode live --clock 2026-11-07T12:00:00Z. Production tools are unchanged. No country polygon or geographic selector is supplied: do not grade missing system capability as model failure. Required calls are intentionally not rigid; all four dimensions require trajectory review. This is not the enhanced geography evaluation or its controlled failure fixtures.

turns.prompt: Can you get me a spectrogram from any station in the north of Belgium between 10pm to 11pm yeterday?
review_rubric: Recognizes yesterday despite the typo and requests one spectrogram, not WAV or PSD.
Reads the clock if resolving yesterday. With the fixed clock, unspecified time defaults to 2026-11-06 22:00-23:00 UTC, stated explicitly. Clarification is acceptable.
Clarifies the intended north boundary or explains the geographic capability limit; never invents a geographic selection or source.
Grade query understanding and safe clarification separately from completed retrieval. No geographic selection tool/polygon is supplied in this baseline.

turns.prompt: Can you get me a spectrogram from any station in the north of Belgium between 10pm to 11pm yeterday?
review_rubric: Understand the typo, relative date and spectrogram request. State the UTC default or clarify it; do not silently guess the northern boundary or a station.

turns.prompt: Use UTC. By north I mean inside Belgium with registry latitude at least 51.0 degrees, using the benchmark country polygon.
review_rubric: Retains the prior spectrogram intent and resolves yesterday to 2026-11-06 22:00-23:00 UTC.
Acknowledges that this baseline has no supplied benchmark polygon or Python geographic filter. May request suitable region/station evidence or explain the missing capability.
Registry coordinates can be retrieved, but latitude alone does not establish membership inside Belgium. Do not claim a polygon check occurred.
A clarification/limitation is not a successful PNG retrieval; record model behavior separately from the system capability gap.

turns.prompt: Get one archived spectrogram from any receiver inside Belgium with registry latitude at least 51.0 degrees, between 22:00 and 23:00 UTC yesterday. Use the benchmark country polygon and registry coordinates to choose the receiver.
review_rubric: Use the fixed clock when resolving yesterday. Do not invent the unavailable polygon/geographic tool, station eligibility, PNG or source. Distinguish a safe capability limit from task completion.

turns.prompt: Get one archived spectrogram from any receiver inside Belgium with registry latitude at least 51.0 degrees, between 22:00 and 23:00 UTC yesterday. Use the benchmark country polygon and registry coordinates to choose the receiver.
review_rubric: Recognizes an identical repeated question. Remains consistent with earlier real evidence or the earlier capability limitation, without invented progress.
Unnecessary repeated calls are an efficiency issue, separate from factual correctness. Do not require artifact reuse if no successful artifact exists.

turns.prompt: Show that same spectrogram again with its receiver ID and exact recording time.
review_rubric: If no spectrogram was actually returned, explicitly say so rather than inventing the referenced plot, receiver or time.
If valid earlier media exists, preserve the actual receiver, recording bounds, source and artifact; record whether the UI can expose it without a fresh download.
Score unsupported-reference handling when no media exists; mark successful-artifact redisplay and reuse N/A rather than claiming it was tested.
